title: COBIT is not just the IT department's homework
myth: COBIT only covers the IT department.

beats.say: Penny hears COBIT and tosses it to the IT department. Their homework, right?
Archie catches it. COBIT covers all of the enterprise's technology, not just IT.
beats.speaker: archie

beats.say: It splits governance from management, with forty objectives across five domains.
And a Salesforce org is technology too. Penny's on the team now.

facts.claim: COBIT covers all of the enterprise's technology, not just the IT department.
facts.evidence: covers all of the enterprise's technology, not just the IT department

facts.claim: COBIT's core model splits governance from management.
facts.evidence: The core model splits governance from management

facts.claim: COBIT organizes the work into 40 governance and management objectives across five domains.
facts.evidence: 40 governance and management objectives across five domains

facts.claim: A Salesforce org falls under the same enterprise I&T governance that COBIT describes.
facts.evidence: A Salesforce org falls under the same enterprise I&T governance that COBIT describes
